allot.subject: Issue of Securities
allot.text: New Delhi Television Limited has informed the Exchange about the raising of funds through the issuance of unsecured, non-convertible perpetual debentures for an amount not exceeding Rs. 800 crores on private placement basis.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: New Delhi Television Limited has submitted to the Exchange regarding the un-audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, and Raising of funds through the issuance of unsecured, non-convertible perpetual debentures for an amount not exceeding Rs. 800 crores on private placement basis, in one or more tranche(s), subject to such regulatory or statutory approvals, as may be required.

allot.subject: Monitoring Agency Report
allot.text: Please find enclosed herewith the Monitoring Agency Report issued by CARE Ratings Limited, with respect to the utilization of proceeds raised through Rights Issue for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.

allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: New Delhi Television Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 11, 2025, titled "Submission of Media Release regarding the closure of the Rights Issue.".

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: New Delhi Television Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 48353450 securities pursuant to Rights Issue at its meeting held on October 09, 2025

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: New Delhi Television Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Letter of Offer dated September 8, 2025, for Rights Issue of fully paid-up Equity Shares'.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Intimation under Regulation 30- Approval of terms and conditions of the Proposed Rights Issue, including the Issue Price, Rights Entitlement Ratio, Record Date, Issue Schedule and other related terms and conditions.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: New Delhi Television Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on September 08, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 3 (Three) Equity Shares for every 4 (Four) Equity Shares held on the Record Date. Issue Price is Rs. 82 per share.

allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: New Delhi Television Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated September 02, 2025, titled "Press Release issued by the Company regarding approval of Rights Issue to its eligible shareholders".
